document.abstract: Surveys and subjective tests were made seeking a consistent method for the day-to-day adjustment of picture monitors in order to secure relatively constant picture conditions. Expressions were derived giving the desired degree of uniformity of ambient light falling on a row of monitors and also giving the white-to-ambient and black-to-ambient luminance relations producing the highest degree in similarity of appearance between monitors in different ambient light. Practical applications of the above expressions were sought and guide lines were derived from a survey of operational preferences of many practicing technicians.
